method: Fresh process per scenario; owner creation to first embedding; five warmups then 200 sequential batches of two texts; RSS after batch 200. Both transports have telemetry disabled before native initialization.
limits: One final run per scenario; allocator, CPU-affinity and scheduling variation are not controlled statistical bounds.
Cold measures owner startup, not whole application startup or disk-cold loading.
RSS is process resident memory, not unique physical memory/PSS.
Compiled Bun continues to use a subprocess because the direct disk worker fails external-package resolution.
